name: zrndr_span_alpha_blend_565_const_alpha_fast_from_pal8
description: zRndr::SpanAlphaBlend565ConstAlphaFastFromPal8 expands 8-bit texture indices through the active palette and blends them into a 5:6:5 destination span using the active constant alpha.
known_limits: VC5SP3 byte verification currently fails: original 0x49d5c0 is 278 bytes, the compiled source loop is 272 bytes, 40 relocation bytes are masked, 14 trailing VC NOPs are trimmed, and 231 unmasked byte mismatches remain.

The mismatch is explained by source-shape/codegen limits: the source preserves the verified paletted 5:6:5 constant-alpha behavior, but VC5SP3 emits an early pixelCount <= 0 guard from the for-loop spelling, different prologue/register allocation, signed V-index shift code, and a different channel-blend instruction order than the retail decrementing loop.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x49d5c0 validates paletted 8-bit texel sampling from g_spanActiveTexels, palette expansion through g_spanActiveTexPalette, source index construction from texU >> 20 plus masked texV shifted by texVShift, and local destination advancement.

The original skips writes when g_spanActiveConstAlphaBits is at most 3, copies the palette color when g_spanActiveConstAlphaBits is at least 252, and otherwise blends 5:6:5 red, green, and blue channels toward the source color using the active constant alpha.
The native smoke verifies full-alpha palette copy, mid-alpha 5:6:5 blending, low-alpha skip behavior, and that g_spanCurrentDst16 is not advanced by the source-faithful implementation.
